label: Multi-Family Housing
seoDescription: Resident wellness amenities for multi-family developments. Boost occupancy & retention with commercial recovery equipment & smart software.

valueProps.title: Used most days, not once a month
valueProps.body: A sauna is the amenity residents actually use. Red light and cold are easy additions in a small room.

valueProps.title: One supplier for all four
valueProps.body: Hyperbaric, cold, heat and light from the same manufacturer. One contract, one install team, one app and one number to call when something needs attention.

valueProps.title: Built to run all day
valueProps.body: Shared-use equipment made for daily traffic, with local parts and technicians.

valueProps.title: Booked from the building app
valueProps.body: Residents book their own slots, and your team gets maintenance alerts rather than phone calls. Daily checks and cleaning still sit with the building team.

features.title: Small footprint, plain requirements
features.body: A dedicated circuit, a finished waterproof floor and ventilation. No plumbing, drains or chemical dosing for the cold room.

features.title: Not the place for hyperbaric
features.body: Chambers need medical oversight, so we don’t recommend them for unsupervised amenity spaces. We’ll say so rather than sell one.
